Name: Nyapu Style Jane Custom NPC
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
She's finally done! After a popular vote and a lot of passionate requests for this one, I decided to finish her up. It took a while because I was under the weather, and she had a lot of expressions to edit. I haven't played with her in my game, personally, so I hope her expressions match. I did look over the dialogue and tried to come up with portraits that would match Nyapu's style and still keep Jane's colorful expressions. I tried my best. If there are any bugs, please let me know, and I'll do my best to fix them. Now on to my next project!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][Main File] CP is just a drag-and-drop into your mods folder. 

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits.
If you do it right, you should get a prompt to replace the original files.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You have two options: normal or neko (cat girl). Pick the one that you like.  [/color]
The CP mod has an added neko beach outfit to match the optional selection. It is not available for the manual replacement mod. 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You will, of course, need the main mod, plus some accompanying frameworks. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16303]Jane - Custom NPC[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17254]Jane - Custom NPC (English)[/url] (Need if you need the mod translated to English)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] (Optional if you want to change the portraits. Highly recommended)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. [/i]
[i]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/101749858]Xasfnhaohghafdajkghaigg[/url]  for allowing me to retexture your mod[/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]Thanks  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62367916]Solariaze[/url] for translating Jane into English[/i]
